annotations.title: Hand a brief to the Berrys agent

description: Start the Berrys agent on a brief and return at once with runId and canvasUrl; it never waits. Follow it with playground_run_events (afterSeq, optionally waitSeconds) for progress, approvals and the final response, and playground_run_diagnose if it fails. projectId defaults to the project the user has open (playground_context_current). files are node IDs of uploaded media to use as references; connectorAccountIds lets the agent read connected sources (needs connector:read). Pass conversationId to continue an earlier brief. Requires agent:start; paid steps still need approval.

connectorAccountIds.description: Connected account IDs (playground_connected_sources_list) the agent may read for this brief. Only include accounts the user selected for this brief.

conversationId.description: Conversation ID for filtering or continuing the associated agent work.

files.description: Reference file attachments to include with the brief.

message.description: User’s creative brief or steering instructions for the current run.

projectId.description: ID of the Playground project chosen for this task; obtain it from project creation, an explicit project link or current context.

name: playground_brief_start

next.description: Suggested next action; it does not authorize spending.
